items.title: PM Modi Urges Citizens To Participate In Census, Calls It 'Collective National Duty'

candidate_claims.text: Written By : IANS | Updated at : 27 Sep 2026 11:45 AM (IST) The Prime Minister reiterated his call to citizens to spare some time for the census.
He noted that the first phase of the initiative is nearly complete, with data for over 32 crore families already recorded in the country.
In Uttarakhand, the process began at Mana village in Chamoli district, widely regarded as the country’s first village, starting with 83-year-old Purnima Rawat.
Recalling his Independence Day appeal on August 15, the Prime Minister reiterated his call to citizens to spare some time for the census.
He emphasised the convenience of the self-registration facility, which allows people to enter information about themselves and their families directly from their mobile phones.

items.title: PM’s remarks during 20th Rozgar Mela via VC

candidate_claims.text: Today, more than 51,000 youth across the nation are receiving appointment letters for government service.
With this vision, initiatives like BRICS CONNECT and the BRICS MSME Cooperation Portal have been launched.
Friends, In recent years, India has signed free trade agreements with nearly 40 countries.
Through this scheme, with an investment of 60,000 crore rupees, 1,000 government ITIs are being modernized.
candidate_claims.context_before: The National Education Policy, Skill India Mission, Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana, and efforts to promote apprenticeships – all aim to ensure that the education and skills of our youth align with the needs of a changing economy.

candidate_claims.text: Today India is the world’s third‑largest startup ecosystem.
And India’s startup story is no longer just about big cities.
Today, nearly half of recognized startups are in tier‑two and tier‑three cities.
With this vision, the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana has been launched.
About 1 lakh crore rupees are being spent on this scheme.
candidate_claims.context_before: With this vision, the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana has been launched.

candidate_claims.text: With its help, nearly 20 million youth will get the chance to join the workforce for the first time.
candidate_claims.context_before: About 1 lakh crore rupees are being spent on this scheme.

candidate_claims.text: Under this scheme, the government is giving an incentive of up to 15,000 rupees to youth who get their first job.
candidate_claims.context_before: With its help, nearly 20 million youth will get the chance to join the workforce for the first time.

candidate_claims.text: Friends, New opportunities for youth are created only when the country’s economy grows, when investment increases, new industries are set up, and new sectors expand.
Today India is one of the fastest‑growing major economies.
In the first quarter of this financial year, India’s growth rate was 7.8 percent.
Investment increased by nearly 12 percent.

In your tenure, you must ensure that obstacles in the path of youth are removed, their ideas get opportunities to move forward, innovation increases investment, and investment creates new employment opportunities.
More than 17 million government employees are connected to the iGOT Karmayogi platform today.
A facility for a farmer may be delivered through your department.

candidate_promises.text: Friends, Today you are joining the Government of India at a time when the nation is moving towards a very big goal – the goal of making India developed by 2047.

The National Education Policy, Skill India Mission, Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana, and efforts to promote apprenticeships – all aim to ensure that the education and skills of our youth align with the needs of a changing economy.
I am confident that wherever you are, in whichever department you are, you will continue to fulfill your duties with dedication and a spirit of service.

items.title: PM’s address at the International Conference on “The Future of Environment and Climate Dynamics”

candidate_claims.text: But the historical truth is that even today, India’s per capita carbon emissions are less than half the global average.
On these very subjects, during COP‑21 in Paris, we launched the book Convenient Action – Continuity for Change.
In the past 12 years, India has made extraordinary progress in every sector related to the environment.

India is the only country in the G20 – I say this before the big leaders of the G20 – the only country that has fulfilled all the commitments it made at the COP‑21 summit in Paris, and has done so ahead of schedule.
This is the strength of Hindustan that I am talking about.
Twelve years ago, India’s solar energy capacity was about 2 gigawatts.
Twelve years ago – 2 gigawatts.
Today it has crossed 160 gigawatts.
From 2 gigawatts to 160 gigawatts in 12 years.
Under the PM Surya Ghar Free Electricity Scheme, we launched the mission to make homes themselves centers of solar power generation.
Under this scheme, more than 5 million homes have already installed rooftop solar panels.
candidate_claims.context_before: Under the PM Surya Ghar Free Electricity Scheme, we launched the mission to make homes themselves centers of solar power generation.

candidate_claims.text: This is more than the total number of homes in many countries.
For this, the government has provided financial assistance of up to 80,000 rupees per household.
Under the KUSUM scheme, the government has installed solar pumps in the fields of 3 million farmers.
We have also completed the ambitious One Nation, One Grid project.
From solar energy alone, India has succeeded in preventing nearly 200 million tonnes of carbon emissions.
Friends, Along with solar energy, India has also achieved major accomplishments in other clean energy sectors.
In the past 12 years, the country’s wind energy capacity has tripled.
Hydropower capacity has increased significantly.
A pathway has also been created to bring private players into this sector.
Because of these efforts, today India’s non‑fossil energy capacity has nearly quadrupled.
Just a few days ago, India’s first hydrogen train was launched – and it is the world’s longest hydrogen train.
Friends, In 12 years, the number of electric vehicles in our country has increased nearly 950 times.
In the year before 2014, fewer than 3,000 EVs were sold in India.
Last year, nearly 2.5 million EVs were sold in India.

items.title: PM’s remarks during the release of instalment under the Annapurna Yojana in West Bengal via VC

candidate_claims.text: On this special occasion, I feel immense happiness to be connected with you.
I have always received great affection from the mothers and sisters of Bengal.
Today, through the Annapurna Yojana, new empowerment is being connected with the mothers and sisters of Bengal.
Friends, Today, the fourth installment of the Annapurna Yojana is reaching the accounts of nearly 15 million sisters.
That means 3,000 rupees every month.
Friends, On May 4th this year, Bengal chose a new path of transformation.
Friends, Solving every problem connected with the life cycle of mothers, sisters, and daughters has been the highest priority of the BJP.
To ensure nutritious food for the child during pregnancy, we launched the Matru Vandana Yojana, sending money directly to women’s bank accounts.
To ensure daughters do not drop out of school due to lack of toilets, we built millions of toilets.
To allow daughters to enter Sainik Schools, we opened their doors.
To help daughters start their own work, we launched the Mudra Yojana with collateral‑free loans.
To ensure mothers could continue their jobs after childbirth, we increased maternity leave.
To provide new earning opportunities in villages, we gave record support to self‑help groups.
To free them from the struggle of fetching water, we launched the Har Ghar Nal Se Jal scheme.
To give daughters access to banks, we opened millions of accounts under Jan Dhan Yojana.
Friends, One of Bengal’s great pains has been that in the past 12 years, many central schemes did not reach here on time.
After the BJP government was formed in Bengal, more than 5 million new poor families have been identified to receive permanent houses under PM Awas.
The PM Vishwakarma Yojana has also been implemented here.

candidate_promises.text: Our government’s goal is that not a single eligible woman should be deprived of the benefits of the Annapurna Yojana.
That is why I say with great confidence – Together we will build a new Bengal.
I am confident that Bengal’s mothers and sisters will continue to give new momentum to this journey of development.

items.title: PM’s speech during the inauguration of SEMICON India 2026

candidate_claims.text: Union Cabinet colleagues Ashwini Vaishnaw ji, Jitin Prasada ji, all industry leaders, CEOs, delegates, and virtually connected hundreds of universities and institutes – the future of India, my young companions.
On one side, our centuries‑old tradition of creation, and on the other side, the technology and vision of the 21st century – this is our inspiration for self‑reliant India, for developed India.
If we look at just the past 15 days – I draw your attention only to 15 days – we can see the direction and speed with which India is moving forward.
In this September, just 10 days ago, the Global Fintech Fest was held in Mumbai.
During the same period, nearly 3,000 kilometers of Dedicated Freight Corridor became fully operational in India.
I am talking about September’s 10 days, not long ago.
And even in this challenging period, India achieved 7.8 percent growth.
And this happened after three decades – nearly 35 years.
Its first edition was in 2022.
In the first edition, we talked about policy.
We began talking about projects – from signing files to laying foundation stones.
And this year, we are talking about commercial production.
Wherever semiconductor ecosystems have been built in the world, they have been prepared after decades of effort.
The size of our first phase was about 8 billion dollars, while the second phase we have set at 13.5 billion dollars.
So far, 12 projects have been approved, and in the next phase this scope will expand further.
And as you were told, we have already trained more than 70,000 youth.
Such a large talent pool is nothing less than a gold mine for all of you.
For years, people in your industry talked about transistor size.
In the past two years, the global semiconductor market has grown by more than 20 percent.
And a very big part of this growth is due to demand created by AI.
That means, today if you are working on AI, the challenges are not only about what is inside the chip, but also about what is happening around it.
In the past decade, our installed solar energy capacity has increased from about 2 gigawatts to more than 160 gigawatts – from 2 to 160.
This sector has been opened to private players.
Just a few years ago, our Constitution completed 75 years.
India’s aspirations are before you, and the new opportunities being created in India are ready to welcome you.

candidate_promises.text: Our government has set a target to train one lakh engineering students for the semiconductor industry.
As AI expands, the need for computing power will increase at the same pace.
